source_text: נוּגֵ֧י מִ/מּוֹעֵ֛ד אָסַ֖פְתִּי מִמֵּ֣/ךְ הָי֑וּ מַשְׂאֵ֥ת עָלֶ֖י/הָ חֶרְפָּֽה׃
source_policy: Same complete pointed WLC; no written/pointed source change or historical-priority vote. Explicit source-interpretation comparison, not merely stylistic editing
scope: Attachment of from-you/they-were and final burden/reproach nominal clause; first grief/festival gloss and have-gathered remain common inputs, not newly certified
close_gloss: Those grieving [construct] / from-the-appointed-festival / I-gathered / from-you [2fs] / they-were / a-burden / upon-her [3fs] / reproach.
accent_limit: Logical punctuation value is relative; later Masoretic grouping not original syntax proof. Review the strongest cross-break/appositional alternative, not an automatic accent veto.

context.source_text: רָנִּי֙ בַּת צִיּ֔וֹן הָרִ֖יעוּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל שִׂמְחִ֤י וְ/עָלְזִי֙ בְּ/כָל לֵ֔ב בַּ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם־־׃
context.text: Sing for joy[a], daughter Zion; shout aloud, Israel! Rejoice and exult with all your heart, daughter Jerusalem!

context.source_text: הֵסִ֤יר יְהוָה֙ מִשְׁפָּטַ֔יִ/ךְ פִּנָּ֖ה אֹֽיְבֵ֑/ךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל יְהוָה֙ בְּ/קִרְבֵּ֔/ךְ לֹא תִֽירְאִ֥י רָ֖ע עֽוֹד׀־׃
context.text: Yahweh has taken away your judgments[a]; he has turned away your enemy. The King of Israel, Yahweh, is in your midst[b]; you will fear evil no more.

context.source_text: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא יֵאָמֵ֥ר לִ/ירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אַל תִּירָ֑אִי צִיּ֖וֹן אַל יִרְפּ֥וּ יָדָֽיִ/ךְ־־׃
context.text: On that day it will be said to Jerusalem[a], “Do not fear”; to Zion, “Do not let your hands grow weak.”

context.source_text: יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהַ֛יִ/ךְ בְּ/קִרְבֵּ֖/ך גִּבּ֣וֹר יוֹשִׁ֑יעַ יָשִׂ֨ישׂ עָלַ֜יִ/ךְ בְּ/שִׂמְחָ֗ה יַחֲרִישׁ֙ בְּ/אַ֣הֲבָת֔/וֹ יָגִ֥יל עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ בְּ/רִנָּֽה׃
context.text: Yahweh your God is in your midst, a mighty one who saves; he will rejoice over you with gladness; he will be quiet in his love[a][b]; he will exult over you with singing.

context.source_text: הִנְ/נִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֛ה אֶת כָּל מְעַנַּ֖יִ/ךְ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֑יא וְ/הוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֶת הַ/צֹּלֵעָ֗ה וְ/הַ/נִּדָּחָה֙ אֲקַבֵּ֔ץ וְ/שַׂמְתִּי/ם֙ לִ/תְהִלָּ֣ה וּ/לְ/שֵׁ֔ם בְּ/כָל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ בָּשְׁתָּֽ/ם־־־־׃
context.text: Behold[a], at that time I will deal with all your oppressors, and I will save the lame and gather the outcast[d][c][b], and I will make them a praise and a name in every land where they were put to shame.

context.source_text: בָּ/עֵ֤ת הַ/הִיא֙ אָבִ֣יא אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם וּ/בָ/עֵ֖ת קַבְּצִ֣/י אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם כִּֽי אֶתֵּ֨ן אֶתְ/כֶ֜ם לְ/שֵׁ֣ם וְ/לִ/תְהִלָּ֗ה בְּ/כֹל֙ עַמֵּ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ בְּ/שׁוּבִ֧/י אֶת שְׁבוּתֵי/כֶ֛ם לְ/עֵינֵי/כֶ֖ם אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה־־׃
context.text: At that time I will bring you in[a], and at that time I will gather you; for I will make you a name and a praise among all the peoples of the earth, when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says Yahweh.
